verdict.line: You lose if you let him farm freely until 6 and eat an Ignite-boosted R; you win if you land W (Infernal Chains) early and chain E (Umbral Dash) into extended trades before his passive can tick.

brief.thesis: Garen has no dash and his only mobility tool, Q (Decisive Strike), just breaks slows and speeds him up — it doesn't let him escape a landed W (Infernal Chains) drag. Once Infernal Chains connects, he's stuck in the fight for its duration while your Deathbringer Stance empowered auto scales off his max health, which is unusually high for a laner. That structural gap is why Aatrox runs a 57.4% win rate over 169 games here, against a 50.5% baseline across all Aatrox top lanes.

theirWindow.when: right after his Q (Decisive Strike) lands
theirWindow.what: His empowered auto silences you on hit, locking out Q/W/E/R for its duration. If he lands it, expect him to immediately follow with E (Judgment) spin while you can't respond — back off contact until the silence window passes.

yourWindow.when: whenever your W and E are both up
yourWindow.what: Land W (Infernal Chains) to drag him in, then E (Umbral Dash) to close and proc the passive heal. Doing this on cooldown matches OP.GG's own read: engaging as soon as your kit resets denies his Perseverance passive the uninterrupted window it needs to regen him back.

powerCurve.note: Both kits weak, only short pokes trade.
W lands, E-sustain outtrades his spin.
Eclipse burst turns W-land into kills.
Full build outscales his flat spin damage.

start.why: Most-picked start at 54.3% over 175 games — the extra sustain and damage support trading into his E (Judgment) spin range before W is up.

boots.why: 77.8% pick, 52.9% win rate — Garen's damage is entirely physical (autos, Q's empowered strike, E's spin), so flat armor blunts every tool he has.

core.why: First item in the best-performing path (61.1% over 18 games) — the burst spike lines up with landing an early W (Infernal Chains) drag.
Second in the top-performing build order — extends the passive-driven healing you get off every empowered auto on his high health pool.
Closes out the strongest recorded path — banks damage through his Q (Decisive Strike) burst and E (Judgment) trades.

situational.when: he starts stacking armor and your autos stop hurting
his level 6+ Ignite plus Demacian Justice burst is threatening to one-shot you
the game runs long and you want cooldown-driven sustained pressure instead of pure burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended fights your W (Infernal Chains) drag forces — stacking damage and healing through a prolonged trade Garen can't walk away from.

summoners.why: Highest-performing and most-picked combo (53.9% WR, 73.3% pick) — Ignite denies his Perseverance regen tick and answers his own Ignite + R execute threat once he hits 6.

playing.title: Bait his Q first
playing.detail: Look for Garen to use Q (Decisive Strike) to poke or farm before you commit E (Umbral Dash). If it's down, his only stick/silence tool is on an 8s cooldown and you can engage freely.

playing.title: Land W to trap him
playing.detail: Infernal Chains reaches 825 range and drags anyone who doesn't clear the impact area — since Garen has no dash, a landed W keeps him locked in the fight until it detonates.

playing.title: Farm the passive off his max HP
playing.detail: Deathbringer Stance's empowered auto deals bonus magic damage scaled to max health, so weave it into every trade — Garen's high base health makes each proc worth more than against a squishier laner.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 execute
playing.detail: Once he's 6, don't sit in an extended trade under roughly 30% HP. Demacian Justice's cooldown drops fast with points (140/110/80/50/20s) and Ignite turns it into a kill threat.

playing.title: Reset on cooldown, not on combo
playing.detail: Re-engage with whichever of Q/W/E is up rather than waiting for a full rotation — every second you're not pressuring him lets Perseverance start regenerating his health back.

playing.title: Poke-farm with E between fights
playing.detail: Umbral Dash heals you passively whenever you damage him, so short E pokes into farm offset his E (Judgment) spin trades without committing your W.

playing.title: Time all-ins to Eclipse completion
playing.detail: Your burst window on a landed W spikes hard the moment Eclipse finishes — look to force the fight right then instead of waiting on the rest of the core.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoners, and the 57.4% win rate over 169 games are measured OP.GG data for the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning about W's drag, Garen's lack of mobility, and the passive's health scaling is our own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Engage Garen whenever your abilities come off cooldown to prevent his (P) from activating. After reaching level 6, be careful of being killed by his Ignite – Demacian Justice (R).
